context_for_next_testing_agent: Individual Awards Tracking feature fully tested. Key features verified: 1) Awards tab on Point Tracking page displays Daily Winners (Flight/Squadron/Cadet/Cadre of Day), Assigned Awards for selected date, Awards History with filtering, and Top Award Recipients. 2) Award types: cadet_of_day, cadre_of_day, flight_honor_graduate, commandants_award, honor_cadet, honor_cadre, leadership_award, pt_excellence, academic_excellence, drill_award, spirit_award, most_improved, other. 3) cadet_of_day and cadre_of_day are auto-eligible for auto-assign. 4) Manual award assignment via Assign Award modal. 5) Auto-Assign Daily button assigns Cadet/Cadre of Day based on highest individual points. 6) Award filtering by type and date range. 7) Delete awards only available to commanders (shows on hover). 8) Awards have color-coded icons and display recipient name, flight/squadron, notes, and auto-generated indicator. 9) C/Amn John Doe currently has 3 awards.
